Winery

Agustí Torelló Mata

Family house in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia specialising in long-aged Cavas, famous for Kripta, presented in an amphora-shaped bottle.

Agustí Torelló Mata is a family winery in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia that bears the name of its founder, a winemaker with long experience in the world of Cava who decided to set up his own house in the second half of the twentieth century. Today it is run by his descendants, who have kept its original focus on sparkling wines with extended ageing.

Vineyards and varieties

The winery sources its grapes from vineyards in the Alt Penedès, many of them fairly old vines, on calcareous and clay soils. It works almost exclusively with the three traditional Cava varieties: Macabeo, Xarel·lo and Parellada. Each variety is vinified separately, often plot by plot, before the base wines are assembled. The house has paid particular attention to reviving classic techniques and to grape selection.

Ageing and style

Its speciality is Reserva and Gran Reserva Cavas with long periods on the lees, in dry styles —Brut and Brut Nature— that seek to express slow evolution in bottle rather than primary fruit. The house's most famous wine is Kripta, a Gran Reserva Brut Nature sold in an amphora-shaped bottle with no flat base, which cannot stand upright and is served from an ice bucket. The range also includes vintage Cavas, rosés made from Trepat and a few still Penedès wines. The overall style is dry, creamy and complex.
